title: What Happens When Your Automated Payment Fails on Cowrywise
summary: If your bank balance is too low for a scheduled Cowrywise payment, we retry with smaller amounts. Here's how it works and how to complete or retry a payment.
body_markdown:
When a scheduled savings or investment payment can’t go through because your bank balance is too low, Cowrywise doesn’t stop at one attempt. We retry with smaller amounts so you can still save something, and then give you a simple way to complete or retry the payment yourself.


This guide covers payments that fail because of a low balance: what’s happening, what you’ll see in the app, and when you need to take action.


## Find your situation


**What you see in the app** **What it means** **What to do**


“We’re processing a payment” banner on your plan A charge is in progress: this could be your scheduled payment or an automatic retry No action needed. We’ll notify you when retries finish


“We processed ₦X of your ₦Y payment” Part of your payment went through Complete the remaining amount, if you want to


“Your payment didn’t go through” None of the retries succeeded Retry the payment


No retry or complete option, and your plan wasn’t funded The time to retry or complete has most likely passed Top up manually whenever you’re ready


## How automatic retries work


If your first payment attempt fails because of insufficient funds, Cowrywise automatically tries again with a smaller amount every six hours, up to four attempts in total, over 18 hours:


**Attempt** **When** **Amount attempted**


Scheduled payment Your scheduled time 100% of your scheduled amount


1st retry 6 hours later 80%


2nd retry 12 hours later 60%


3rd retry 18 hours later 40%


4th retry 24 hours later 20%


Automatic retries stop after the first successful attempt, so the retry sequence never debits you more than once for the same scheduled payment. Each retry also moves to the next smaller amount, even if your balance has gone up since the last attempt. Where a reduced amount would fall below your plan’s minimum contribution, the plan minimum applies.


You don’t need to turn this on. Retries run automatically on locked savings plans that have automation enabled.


While retries are in progress, you’ll see a banner on that plan’s details page, and we’ll notify you by push and email when retries begin and when a payment succeeds.


### **An example**


You’ve scheduled ₦50,000 a month to your December Holiday plan. On your payment date, you have ₦25,000 in your bank account.


**Attempt** **Amount** **Result**


Scheduled payment ₦50,000 Insufficient funds


1st retry ₦40,000 Insufficient funds


2nd retry ₦30,000 Insufficient funds


3rd retry ₦20,000 Successful


4th retry ₦10,000 Not attempted


₦20,000 goes into your plan instead of nothing. Your schedule doesn’t change: next month, Cowrywise will attempt the full ₦50,000 again.


## Complete a partial payment


If only part of your payment went through, you can pay the rest once automatic retries have finished. In the example above, that’s the remaining ₦30,000.


1. Tap the reminder we send you, the action card on your home screen, or the banner on your plan’s details page.
2. Check the outstanding amount and the payment method. You can change the payment method here.
3. Tap Complete now.


The full outstanding amount needs to be in your account. Unlike automatic retries, this doesn’t step down to smaller amounts. If you’d rather add a smaller amount, use a regular manual top-up instead.


## Retry a failed payment


If none of the automatic attempts succeeded, you can retry the full scheduled amount once automatic retries have finished.


2. Check the amount and the payment method. You can change the payment method here.
3. Tap Retry now.


If it doesn’t go through, you can try again as many times as you need while the option is available.


## How long you have


After automatic retries finish, you’ll have a limited time to retry a failed payment or complete a partial one. How long you have depends on how often your plan is funded: daily, weekly, or monthly.


We’ll send you reminders by push notification and email while the option is open. If it’s no longer available, you can still top up your plan manually.


## Topping up manually while retries are in progress


You can top up your plan manually at any time. But a manual top-up doesn’t cancel automatic retries that are already in progress, so a retry could still debit your account after you’ve topped up.


To avoid an extra debit you didn’t plan for, check your plan’s details page before topping up. If it shows a payment-in-progress banner, wait until automatic retries finish. Then check the payment status and use Retry now or Complete now if you need to.


## If you don’t retry or complete a payment


You’ll miss that contribution, but your plan won’t be cancelled. When the time to retry or complete passes:


- Your plan and automation stay active.
- Your next scheduled payment goes ahead as normal, for your usual amount.
- The missed amount isn’t added to your next payment.


You can still top up manually whenever you want.


### **Frequently Asked Questions**


**Money came into my account after the first attempt failed. Will the next retry take the full amount?**


No. Each retry follows the step-down sequence, so the next attempt will be for 80% of your scheduled amount, even if you now have enough for the full payment. Once retries finish, you can complete the remaining amount in the app


**Can I make the full payment myself before the 18 hours are up?**


The Retry now and Complete now options only appear after automatic retries finish. Before then, you can top up manually.


**Will I be debited four times?**


No. The four stages are attempts. Once one succeeds, the rest are cancelled.


**Why was a smaller amount taken instead of my full payment?**


Your balance wasn’t enough for the full amount at the time, so a smaller retry went through. You can complete the rest in the app.


**Does a partial payment change my plan?**


No. Your scheduled amount and dates stay exactly the same.
